goals.title: Ship queued recs every run
goals.description: shipped=0 while rec_count>0 (current state: 15 recs, 0 shipped, 16 deferred) means a blockage - usually required-model-unavailable. Verified emitted key.
directives: Honor required_model_for_batch(); defer rather than downgrade Opus-bound authoring
Report the blocking reason in the run summary when shipped=0

goals.title: Drain the deferred-rec backlog
goals.description: Deferred recs should clear as soon as their blocker (usually Opus availability) lifts. Verified emitted key.
directives: Respect defer_backoff cooldowns; never hot-loop a deferred rec
Surface deferral reasons so the operator can fix the root cause (pool auth, proxy)

goals.title: Every run exits cleanly
goals.description: Non-zero exit_code means run.sh crashed rather than completed/deferred. Verified emitted key.
directives: Fail closed: write deferred.json instead of crashing when a backend is unreachable
